summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtins feature in the botocore repo (not committed). Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members and values from the spec, each with a type comment. (2) botocore/args.py makes the STS global-endpoint predicate accept an absent endpoint configuration (no variant tags), imports the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. It reads FIPS and DualStack through the bridge's lookups, reuses the S3 and STS predicates, and takes SDK::Endpoint from the client URL, then the legacy URL under custom data. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion; the S3 predicate test asserts exactly one call. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; tests/unit/test_regions.py and tests/unit/test_client.py 356 passed. No added line exceeds 79 columns. Black was not available in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand. The bridge's private lookup methods were called directly, as the spec requires.
